subject: Post-demo: proposed POC timetable, success metrics, and owners — VenturerX
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ari Patel <ari.patel@venturerx.com>, Maya Singh <maya.singh@venturerx.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Jul 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: proposed POC timetable, success metrics, and owners — VenturerX

Hi Ari / Maya —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our side and a proposed POC approach so we can lock dates and owners. High level: you want a 4-week trial that validates (1) accuracy on ticket-classification and response-suggestion, (2) 99th-percentile latency <= 450ms for avg payloads, and (3) integration with your Zendesk instance for live A/B traffic. Correct me if I missed anything.

Attached: VenturerX_POC_checklist.xlsx (timeline + owner matrix) and sample_data_spec.md (data snapshot examples and S3 layout).

Proposed POC outline (quick view):
- Week 0 (prep): data handoff + access (S3 read, Zendesk sandbox, KMS keys) — VenturerX owns data handoff; Redwood owns model selection/infra prep.
- Week 1 (ingest + baseline): run baseline eval on 10k historical tickets, measure accuracy & latency.
- Week 2 (integration + shadow): Zendesk shadow routing for 5% traffic, monitor latency and correctness.
- Week 3 (iter & thresholding): tune prompts & batching, run acceptance tests.
- Week 4 (handoff + SLA prep): report, final acceptance sign-off, rollback plan.

Success criteria (proposal):
- Precision@top1 >= 82% on labeled sample set
- False-positive rate for escalation suggestions <= 5%
- 99th percentile latency <= 450ms under 5rps steady load
- End-to-end integration validated in sandbox and CI smoke tests pass

Owners (proposed):
- VenturerX: Ari (data + sandbox), Maya (product), procurement@venturerx.com (contracts)
- Redwood: Rachel (AE / program owner), Ben (Solutions Eng — integration + metrics), Soojin (SRE — infra & SLA runbook)

Immediate asks from VenturerX:
1) Confirm the success criteria above or send edits by EOD Wed.
2) Confirm dataset availability and expected handoff date (S3 + sample access).
3) Procurement contact for contract/NDAs — copy to procurement@venturerx.com if ready.

If that looks good I can circulate a one-page mutual action plan and book a 30-min kickoff for next Tue or Wed.

Thanks,
Rachel Kim
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0148

Attachments: VenturerX_POC_checklist.xlsx (Excel, 45KB), sample_data_spec.md (text, 3KB)

Subject: Re: Post-demo: proposed POC timetable, success metrics, and owners — VenturerX

Thanks Rachel — this is really clear and appreciated. Quick responses inline: 

- The objectives look right. One addition: include a small qualitative eval where our support leads rate response helpfulness (5-point scale) on a ~500-ticket holdout. Can Redwood incorporate that into Week 1 baseline?
- We can hand off a sanitized S3 sample by Fri 31 Jul; full dataset access will require a short security checklist (we'll send to your security team).
- Procurement is looped (procurement@venturerx.com) — they'll want a short statement of work and standard MSP terms.

On timing: Fri dataset handoff + kickoff the following Tue (Aug 3) works for us. If Redwood can confirm owners and a kickoff agenda, we'll lock the calendar.

Ari — any concern on the sandbox side?

Best,
Maya Singh
Head of Product — VenturerX
maya.singh@venturerx.com

- Qual eval: we can do the 500-ticket human rating in Week 1. We suggest a rubric (helpful / somewhat helpful / not helpful / harmful) — will include in the checklist.
- Contract: for the POC we'll use a short Terms Addendum (no charge trial with data-use limits). Rachel — can you coordinate with procurement to get a signed addendum by Aug 2?
